messages:
Alex K: Heads up — link-checker flagged a 404 for a shortlink used in the runbook. The shortlink is slim.rs/ntf3 which used to redirect to /docs/model-onboarding/credentials but now returns 404. Can someone own a tiny fix? :eyes:

linkbot: Automated scan found 404 on slim.rs/ntf3 referenced in /kb/2024/model-onboard.md

Maria P: I can take this. Do we want to replace with the full canonical path or create a new shortlink? I don’t have push perms to the handbook repo though.

Kai: Please replace with the canonical URL: https://internal.redwood.com/docs/model-onboarding/credentials. Also add a one-line note in the doc for the migration script. No need to issue a new shortlink for now.

Alex K: Thanks — Maria, can you open a PR and ping @Sam L for a quick review? If we can get this in before EOD the CI smokecheck will stop failing.

Sam L: Will review. If you want a sed snippet for multi-file replacement I can paste it here.

Maria P: PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood.com/docs/handbook/-/merge_requests/432 — tiny replace + lint. Requesting review from @Sam L.

Sam L: Reviewing now. Tiny nit: update the commit message to "replace slimlink -> canonical url to avoid 404s" and add an entry to docs/changelog/2026-03.md noting the fix. Also consider adding the old shortlink to the link-check exceptions if we plan to re-enable shortlinks later.

Kai: Optional: add a short note in the changelog so Support isn't surprised by the missing redirect.

linkbot: Link-checker re-run at 3023456812 — no errors for /kb/2024/model-onboard.md after the merge.

Alex K: :thumbsup: Amazing, quick turnaround. Thanks Maria and Sam!
